gloss: downy hair; peach fuzz; fine body hair

definitions.gloss: downy hair; peach fuzz; fine body hair; vellus hair
definitions.explanation: The soft, fine hair that covers the skin, especially noticeable on the face, arms, and nape of the neck. Also refers to the delicate hair on a newborn baby. Composed of 産 (birth) + 毛 (hair), originally meaning the hair a baby is born with.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{産毛|うぶげ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{柔|やわ}らかい→柔らかい：01096_yawarakai⟧。
examples.english: A baby's downy hair is very soft.
Shaving the peach fuzz on your face makes makeup go on more smoothly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{桃|もも}→桃：04382_momo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{表面|ひょうめん}→表面：03587_hyoumen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{産毛|うぶげ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧⟦{毛|け}→毛：01392_ke⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|は}えている→生える：02392_haeru⟧。
examples.english: The surface of a peach has fine hair like downy fuzz growing on it.

notes:
USAGE:
{産毛|うぶげ} can refer to the fine hair on a baby (its original meaning) or the fine vellus hair on anyone's skin. It is commonly discussed in the context of facial grooming and skincare, as removing {産毛|うぶげ} is a popular beauty practice in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{産毛|うぶげ} (facial peach fuzz)

- {産毛|うぶげ}⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧ (downy hair removal)
